```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup and Dependencies

```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Check and install required packages
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "ggplot2", "ggrepel", "tibble", "purrr", "plotly", "tidyr", "scales", "htmlwidgets")
for (pkg in required_packages) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
        install.packages(pkg, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
    }
}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tibble)
library(plotly)
library(tidyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

## Define Paths

```{r paths}
count_dir <- "../data/TMZ_survival_screen/raw_counts"
sample_sheet_path <- "../data/TMZ_survival_screen/WITH_AXIS_final_CROP_samplesheet_20bp_1000pooled_guides_uniquenumbers_12_2_25.txt"
metadata_path <- "../02_targeted_cCRE_screen/outputs/TMZ_survival_screen_sgRNA_library/TMZ_survival_screen_pooled_1000_guides_for_publishing.csv"
output_dir <- "./outputs_BE4max_TMZ_survival"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

## Data Loading and Merging

```{r load_data}
# 1. Read Sample Sheet (GuideID -> Sequence)
sample_sheet <- read.table(sample_sheet_path, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(sample_sheet) <- c("GuideID", "Sequence", "Unk")
sample_sheet <- sample_sheet %>% dplyr::select(GuideID, Sequence)

# 2. Read Metadata (Sequence -> ATAC_bin, Gene.Symbol)
metadata_subset <- read.csv(metadata_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Read extended metadata
extended_metadata_path <- "../02_targeted_cCRE_screen/outputs/merged_crop_library_samplesheet.csv"
extended_metadata <- read.csv(extended_metadata_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Merge: Keep rows from metadata_subset (the 1000 guides) and join with extended_metadata
# We join on sgRNA.sequence and ATAC_bin
# Use suffix to preserve original column names (e.g. df_name) and mark extended ones
metadata <- metadata_subset %>%
    left_join(extended_metadata, by = c("sgRNA.sequence", "ATAC_bin"), suffix = c("", ".extended")) %>%
    rename(Sequence = sgRNA.sequence)

# Create guide_type column
metadata$guide_type <- ifelse(!is.na(metadata$ATAC_bin) & metadata$ATAC_bin != "",
    metadata$ATAC_bin,
    metadata$df_name
)
# Handle cases where both might be NA/empty
metadata$guide_type[is.na(metadata$guide_type) | metadata$guide_type == ""] <- "Unknown"

# 3. Read Count Files (strip GEO prefix and support gzipped input dynamically)
count_files <- list.files(count_dir, pattern = "_counts.txt(\\.gz)?$", full.names = TRUE)

counts_list <- lapply(count_files, function(f) {
    con <- if (grepl("\\.gz$", f)) gzfile(f) else f
    d <- read.table(con, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(d) <- c("Count", "GuideID")
    
    sample_name <- basename(f)
    sample_name <- gsub("^GSM[0-9]+_BE4max_TMZ_survival_", "", sample_name)
    sample_name <- gsub("_counts\\.txt(\\.gz)?$", "", sample_name)
    
    d %>% rename(!!sample_name := Count)
})

# Merge all count dataframes
count_matrix_df <- counts_list %>% purrr::reduce(full_join, by = "GuideID")
count_matrix_df[is.na(count_matrix_df)] <- 0

# Save Raw Counts with Metadata
raw_counts_w_metadata <- count_matrix_df %>%
    left_join(sample_sheet, by = "GuideID") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "Sequence")

# Reorder columns
sample_cols <- sort(colnames(count_matrix_df)[colnames(count_matrix_df) != "GuideID"])
other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(raw_counts_w_metadata), c("GuideID", sample_cols))
raw_counts_w_metadata <- raw_counts_w_metadata %>%
    select("GuideID", all_of(sample_cols), all_of(other_cols))

raw_counts_csv_path <- file.path(output_dir, "BE4max_NOT_sorted_raw_guide_count_w_metadata.csv")
write.csv(raw_counts_w_metadata, raw_counts_csv_path, row.names = FALSE)
print(paste("Saved raw counts with metadata to:", raw_counts_csv_path))
```

## Filter Low-Coverage Midiprep Artifacts
In this step, we remove guides that were identified as being in the bottom 1.5% of the Midiprep library coverage. These guides are prone to  artifacts and are excluded before analysis.

```{r filter_midiprep_artifacts}
# 1. Load the list of bottlenecked guides
midiprep_cutoff_path <- "../data/TMZ_survival_screen/use_for_cutoff_low_coverage_guides_bottom_1.5pct.csv"

if (file.exists(midiprep_cutoff_path)) {
    low_cov_guides_to_remove <- read.csv(midiprep_cutoff_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    # Display guides being removed
    print(paste("Removing", nrow(low_cov_guides_to_remove), "guides identified as low-coverage Midiprep artifacts:"))
    print(low_cov_guides_to_remove %>% select(GuideID, Mean_Counts))
    
    # 2. Filter the main dataset
    n_before <- nrow(raw_counts_w_metadata)
    raw_counts_w_metadata <- raw_counts_w_metadata %>%
        anti_join(low_cov_guides_to_remove, by = "GuideID")
    n_after <- nrow(raw_counts_w_metadata)
    
    print(paste("Guides before filter:", n_before))
    print(paste("Guides after filter:", n_after))
    print(paste("Successfully removed", n_before - n_after, "guides."))
    
} else {
    stop("ERROR: Midiprep cutoff file not found. Ensure the midiprep analysis script has been run.")
}
```

## Analysis: Proportion Relative to Average DMSO

```{r analysis}
# Define Sample Groups
dmso_cols <- c("01DD01_S1", "02DD02_S2", "03DD03_S3")
tmz_cols <- c("04DD04_S4", "05DD05_S5", "06DD06_S6")

# 1. Calculate Average DMSO Count per Guide
# We use the raw counts dataframe for calculation
df <- raw_counts_w_metadata

# Ensure numeric
for (col in c(dmso_cols, tmz_cols)) {
    df[[col]] <- as.numeric(df[[col]])
}

# Row-wise average for DMSO
df$average_DMSO_count <- rowMeans(df[, dmso_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Calculate NTC Normalization Factor
# "average NTC_TMZ / average NTC_DMSO"
# Identify NTC rows
ntc_rows <- grepl("non_targeting_control", df$guide_type)

# Average NTC Count in DMSO (Global average of all NTCs across all DMSO replicates)
# Sum of all NTC counts in DMSO / (Number of NTCs * Number of Replicates)
ntc_dmso_vals <- unlist(df[ntc_rows, dmso_cols])
avg_ntc_dmso <- mean(ntc_dmso_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

# Average NTC Count in TMZ
ntc_tmz_vals <- unlist(df[ntc_rows, tmz_cols])
avg_ntc_tmz <- mean(ntc_tmz_vals, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calculate Scaling Factor (Log2 Ratio of NTCs)
# calculate Total Library Counts to convert to proportions.

# Total Counts per Sample
total_counts <- colSums(df[, c(dmso_cols, tmz_cols)], na.rm = TRUE)
avg_total_dmso <- mean(total_counts[dmso_cols])
avg_total_tmz <- mean(total_counts[tmz_cols])

# Proportion NTC DMSO = Avg_NTC_DMSO / Avg_Total_DMSO
prop_ntc_dmso <- avg_ntc_dmso / avg_total_dmso
prop_ntc_tmz <- avg_ntc_tmz / avg_total_tmz

# NTC Shift (Log2 Ratio)
ntc_shift <- log2(prop_ntc_tmz / prop_ntc_dmso)

print(paste("Average NTC DMSO Count:", avg_ntc_dmso))
print(paste("Average NTC TMZ Count:", avg_ntc_tmz))
print(paste("NTC Shift (Log2FC):", ntc_shift))

# 3. Calculate Scaled Log2FC for Each Guide and Each TMZ Replicate
# We want to plot each TMZ replicate individually against the Average DMSO.
# Pivot TMZ columns to long format
long_df <- df %>%
    select(
        GuideID, guide_type, df_name, genomic_start, genomic_end, average_DMSO_count,
        ATAC_bin_start, Sequence, sgRNA, sgRNA.Strand, X..edits, Nucleotide.edits, Amino.acid.edits, Mutation.category,
        all_of(tmz_cols)
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(tmz_cols), names_to = "TMZ_Sample", values_to = "TMZ_Count")

# Ensure genomic_start is numeric for correct sorting
long_df$genomic_start <- as.numeric(long_df$genomic_start)
long_df$ATAC_bin_start <- as.numeric(long_df$ATAC_bin_start)

# Calculate Proportions
# We need the total count for each specific TMZ sample
long_df$Total_TMZ_Sample <- total_counts[long_df$TMZ_Sample]
long_df$Total_Avg_DMSO <- avg_total_dmso

# Add pseudocount
long_df$Prop_TMZ <- (long_df$TMZ_Count + 1) / (long_df$Total_TMZ_Sample + 1)
long_df$Prop_Avg_DMSO <- (long_df$average_DMSO_count + 1) / (long_df$Total_Avg_DMSO + 1)

# Calculate Raw Log2FC
long_df$Log2FC <- log2(long_df$Prop_TMZ / long_df$Prop_Avg_DMSO)

# Apply NTC Scaling (Subtract the shift to center NTCs at 0)
long_df$Scaled_Log2FC <- long_df$Log2FC - ntc_shift

# 4. Filter out NTCs for Plotting
plot_df <- long_df %>% filter(!grepl("non_targeting_control", guide_type))

# ==========================================
# NEW: Calculate Null Distribution from GuideID Patterns
# ==========================================
# Calculate null distribution based on patterns found in the GuideID column
null_stats <- plot_df %>%
    # Use grepl to find either pattern anywhere in the GuideID string
    filter(grepl("local_negative_controls|AAVS1_negative_control", GuideID)) %>%
    summarize(
        mu = mean(Scaled_Log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
        sigma = sd(Scaled_Log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_guides = n_distinct(GuideID)
    )

# Establish the Conservative Threshold (2 Sigma)
combined_threshold <- null_stats$mu + (2 * null_stats$sigma)

# Output results for verification
print(paste("Number of unique control guides found:", null_stats$n_guides))
print(paste("Conservative Threshold (2-sigma):", round(combined_threshold, 4)))

# Save threshold to file for downstream use
threshold_path <- file.path(output_dir, "combined_threshold.csv")
write.csv(data.frame(combined_threshold = combined_threshold), threshold_path, row.names = FALSE)
print(paste("Saved threshold to:", threshold_path))
# ==========================================

# ==========================================
# NEW: Stouffer’s Z-score Method for Combined P-values
# ==========================================

# 1. Calculate Individual Z-scores for every replicate
# This measures how many standard deviations each point is from the null mean
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
        z_score = (Scaled_Log2FC - null_stats$mu) / null_stats$sigma
    )

# 2. Combine Z-scores for each GuideID (Stouffer's Method)
guide_level_stats <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(GuideID, guide_type, df_name, genomic_start, genomic_end) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_scaled_LFC = mean(Scaled_Log2FC, na.rm = TRUE),
        # Stouffer's formula: sum(Z) / sqrt(k) where k=3 replicates
        combined_z = sum(z_score, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
        # Total number of replicates used for this guide
        n_reps = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # 3. Convert Combined Z to P-value and Q-value
    mutate(
        # Two-tailed p-value calculation
        stouffer_p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(combined_z)),
        # Apply Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) Multiple Hypothesis Correction
        q_value = p.adjust(stouffer_p, method = "BH")
    )

# 4. Save the results to your project folder
stouffer_results_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Guide_Level_Stouffers_Results.csv")
write.csv(guide_level_stats, stouffer_results_path, row.names = FALSE)

print(paste("Stouffer's analysis complete. Saved to:", stouffer_results_path))

# 5. Quick check: How many guides pass at q < 0.01?
n_sig <- sum(guide_level_stats$q_value < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
print(paste("Number of unique guides with q < 0.01:", n_sig))

# Filter for significant hits (FDR < 1%)
# We arrange by q_value so your most confident hits are at the top
significant_hits <- guide_level_stats %>%
    filter(q_value < 0.01) %>%
    arrange(q_value)

# Save the significant hits to a separate CSV for easy sharing/referencing
sig_hits_path <- file.path(output_dir, "Significant_Guides_q_less_0.01.csv")
write.csv(significant_hits, sig_hits_path, row.names = FALSE)

print(paste("Found", nrow(significant_hits), "significant guides at q < 0.01."))
print(paste("Significant hits saved to:", sig_hits_path))

# Display the top 10 hits in your R console/HTML report
head(significant_hits, 10)# ==========================================
# Export final dataset for downstream stacked jitter plots
# ==========================================
plot_df_stouffer <- plot_df %>%
    left_join(guide_level_stats %>% select(GuideID, q_value), by = "GuideID") %>%
    mutate(
        is_significant = !is.na(q_value) & q_value < 0.01,
        Legend_Label_Stouffer = ifelse(is_significant, guide_type, "Not Significant")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        primary_sort = ifelse(guide_type == "AAVS1_negative_control", 0, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(
        primary_sort,
        ATAC_bin_start,
        genomic_start,
        GuideID
    ) %>%
    mutate(GuideID = factor(GuideID, levels = unique(GuideID)))

# Match legacy column order
cols_order <- c(
    "GuideID", "guide_type", "df_name", "genomic_start", "genomic_end",
    "average_DMSO_count", "ATAC_bin_start", "Sequence", "sgRNA", "sgRNA.Strand",
    "X..edits", "Nucleotide.edits", "Amino.acid.edits", "Mutation.category",
    "TMZ_Sample", "TMZ_Count", "Total_TMZ_Sample", "Total_Avg_DMSO",
    "Prop_TMZ", "Prop_Avg_DMSO", "Log2FC", "Scaled_Log2FC", "z_score",
    "primary_sort", "q_value", "is_significant", "Legend_Label_Stouffer"
)
plot_df_stouffer <- plot_df_stouffer %>% select(all_of(cols_order))

stouffer_data_csv <- file.path(output_dir, "bottom_1pt5percent_guides_removed_BE4max_plot_df_stouffer_data_final.csv")
write.csv(plot_df_stouffer, stouffer_data_csv, row.names = FALSE)
print(paste("Saved Stouffer's plotting data to:", stouffer_data_csv))
```
